summary: 10.0.38.05 Desktop Dynamic KPI Single-Panel Engine & 38-Screen Unique Icon/Color Parity: Single-Row Never-Wrap Ribbon Authority (8 Cards on Bank Statement in One Panel), 58px Standard Desktop Height, Usable-Width Dynamic Density (Normal/Compact/Dense) with ResizeObserver, and 100% Semantic Icon & 10-Color Palette Parity matching Desktop ResponsiveKpiLayoutManager.java and UiSemanticRegistry.java
highlights: 1. Single-Panel Never-Wrap Authority: All KPI cards strictly stay in ONE horizontal ribbon row, completely preventing wrap to row 2 even with 8 cards (e.g. Bank Statement) or when side drawers open.
2. Desktop Height Parity (58px Compact Ribbon): Aligned all KPI cards to exact 58px Desktop height with 2-row layout, saving maximum vertical space for data tables.
3. Usable-Width Responsive Density: Implemented Desktop ResponsiveKpiLayoutManager density thresholds (Dense <170px or 7+ cards, Compact 170-225px, Normal >225px) driven by native ResizeObserver.
4. 38 Screens & Sub-Screens Full Parity: Comprehensive audit and enhancement across all 38 KPI-enabled screens and sub-screens.

5. Unique Colorful Icons & 10-Color Families: Full semantic color palette (Emerald, Sky Blue, Indigo, Purple, Amber, Crimson Red, Teal, Cyan, Gold) with unique vibrant icons and hover tooltips matching Desktop.
6. Interactive Drill-Down Filtering: Clicking any enhanced KPI card immediately activates corresponding filter dropdowns.
